policy: Frozen before the implementation (issue #112). Targets: lengthening edits refused because the paragraph would leave the rectangular panel holding it, with free space below the panel. A panel extension is a layout change: it is made only when the proposal lists it and its own id is approved for this edit (acknowledge_inference, a chain id or an earlier approval never approves it). Only the panel's bottom moves, by the least the text needs; its top, sides, colours, line style, transparency and drawing order stay. A missing input, a refusal or a fixture is never a real-PDF success; negative cases must stay refused.
procedure: freeze: what the B2 at the freeze proposes and why its save is refused; the drawings around the paragraph
run old (main) and new: propose, save unapproved (must be refused when an approval is needed), approve exactly the listed candidates and save; edit back from the saved PDF alone the same way

survey.method: paragraphs whose rows lie in a filled single-rectangle drawing (re + fill), at most one line pitch above its bottom, nothing else in it below them; free space below the rectangle across its width (drawings, words, images); pages 1-8
